title: Signed totalization of the ordinary scalar tensor square
statement: For the same coefficient data d and h and every pair of unbounded internal R cochain complexes P,Q, ES applied termwise to the internal signed-total scalar tensorator, followed by the total section comparison and the termwise scalar comparison on the factors, equals the termwise scalar comparison on P tensor Q followed by the scalar image of the total R section comparison and the signed-total section scalar tensorator. No K-flatness or termwise flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07A4, degreewise ordinary tensor compatibility and signed direct-sum totalization; Modules on Sites, Tags 03EK and 03EL.

proof.text: In degree n, use coproduct extensionality after the scalar-and-section functor on the direct-sum total tensor. On each summand p+q=n, coefficientScalarTensor_summand gives the required equality. Hence the chain maps are equal.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4, the ordinary comparison and the passage to unbounded total complexes.
